purpose: gnsslad6 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 146): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..5 then NEW step 6 (2 s console pause first): + BGFSYS_ON_TOP power 0x18000008 key|bit7. Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
